name: Comments and replies
summary: Discussion threads on notes and other items, and who may edit or remove comments and replies.

roles.note: Editing and deleting depend on authorship or being a system admin on the project, not on permission strings.

nfr.statement: Time for a new comment to appear for other people viewing the same item.
nfr.open_question: Must comments appear live, or is on-refresh acceptable?

requirements.title: Only the author edits a reply; author, comment author or admin removes it
requirements.statement: A blank reply is rejected. Only a reply's author can edit it; anyone else's edit silently does nothing. A reply can be removed by its author, the comment's author, or a system admin on the project.
open_checks: An unauthorised edit returns null rather than an error; clients must not show it as saved

acceptance_criteria.given: User A's reply on user B's comment
acceptance_criteria.then: It is removed, because B wrote the comment

requirements.title: Comments are deleted by their author or a system admin
requirements.statement: A comment can be deleted only by its author or a system admin on the project.

acceptance_criteria.given: A collaborator who didn't write a comment
